top_5_findings.summary: OpenAI is working on a new Agents platform for ChatGPT that allows users to create, configure, and manage their own 24/7, always-on agents. Roles mentioned: 'Data Analyst', 'Chief of Staff,' etc. Competitive threat to self-hosted agents like Hermes.

top_5_findings.summary: Microsoft has begun rolling out AI agent support in Windows 11 through new APIs in latest Release Preview builds. Third-party AI agents can now integrate into the Taskbar. Major OS-level platform shift for agent frameworks.
